title.zh: 为什么保管好私钥并不总能阻止加密货币被盗
title.en: Why keeping your private keys safe won’t always stop crypto theft

current_state.zh: 9月6日，Liquid 因软件批准了一笔本不应合格的提款而流失近 4,000 枚比特币，尽管授权该提款的私钥并未被盗；据 TRM Labs 还原，攻击者利用软件缺陷创建了没有比特币背书的 L-BTC，并将其兑换成真实比特币。加密货币保险可能承保损失，但不保证客户获得全额赔偿，且若以美元而非比特币计算赔付，即使成功还款也可能让客户仍遭受短缺。
current_state.en: On Sept. 6, Liquid lost almost 4,000 Bitcoin through a withdrawal its software approved even though the private keys used to authorize it had not been stolen; according to TRM Labs' reconstruction, attackers exploited a software flaw to create L-BTC without backing Bitcoin and exchanged those tokens for real coins. Crypto insurance can cover losses without guaranteeing customers full reimbursement, and even successful repayment can leave customers short if compensation is calculated in dollars instead of Bitcoin.
